worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.summary: Snatches a small stone from the ground at the user's feet and slings it flat and fast at a chosen direction or point: one stone, one hit, shards on impact. It can be thrown freely with no target locked; it does not home, so a target that steps after release slips it; the lob choice clears a low wall but scatters more and flies slower.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.use.0: Cheap ranged chip you can throw again and again
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.use.1: Reliable single shots at a target standing still
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.use.2: Use the lob choice to strike over cover at a target behind it
Deals %1$s physical damage to a living target, with a %2$s block stone radius.
The stone flies at %1$s blocks/tick and reaches %2$s blocks with ±%3$s° spread. It does not home, so the farther it goes the easier it is to slip.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.lob.on: Lob: throws the stone on an arc that clears a low wall or cover to hit a target behind it; costs spread x1.5, stone speed x0.82, power x0.9 and wind-up +2 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.lob.off: Flat throw: the stone flies straight and fast at body height, more accurate and heavier; costs being blocked by a low wall in front.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.growth.0: From level %1$s the stone power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.growth.1: From level %1$s the stone power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.preference.l: On: throws the stone high so it clears a low wall or cover to hit a target behind it, at the cost of spread x1.5, stone speed x0.82, power x0.9 and wind-up +2 ticks. Off (flat throw): the stone flies straight and fast, more accurate and heavier, but a low wall stops it.
worldcombat.skill.rockthrow.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank higher so the throw finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
